options.name: aggr_list
options.description: List of aggregates to host target FlexCache volume.

options.name: aggr_list_multiplier
options.description: Aggregate list repeat count. REST - Number of FlexCache constituents per aggregate when the C(aggregates) field is mentioned.

options.name: atime_scrub
options.description: Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.14.1 or later.

options.name: auto_provision_as
options.description: Use this parameter to automatically select existing aggregates for volume provisioning.  Eg flexgroup Note that the fastest aggregate type with at least one aggregate on each node of the cluster will be selected. Ignored when using REST - omit aggr_list for automatic selection.

options.name: cert_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client cert file (.pem). not supported with python 2.6.

options.name: cifs_change_notify_enabled
options.description: Specifies whether a CIFS change notification is enabled for the FlexCache volume. Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.15.1 or later.

options.name: dr_cache
options.description: If set to true, a DR cache is created. Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.9 or later.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: force_offline
options.description: Offline FlexCache volume before deleting the FlexCache relationship. The volume will be destroyed and data can be lost.

options.name: force_ontap_version
options.description: Override the cluster ONTAP version when using REST. The behavior is undefined if the version does not match the target cluster. This is provided as a work-around when the cluster version cannot be read because of permission issues. See https://github.com/ansible-collections/netapp.ontap/wiki/Known-issues. This should be in the form 9.10 or 9.10.1 with each element being an integer number. When C(use_rest) is set to auto, this may force a switch to ZAPI based on the version and platform capabilit

options.name: force_unmount
options.description: Unmount FlexCache volume. Delete the junction path at which the volume is mounted before deleting the FlexCache relationship.

options.name: global_file_locking_enabled
options.description: Specifies whether or not a FlexCache volume has global file locking mode enabled. When global file locking mode is enabled, the 'is_disconnected_mode_off_for_locks' flag is always set to 'true'. Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.9 or later.

options.name: guarantee_type
options.description: Specifies The type of space guarantee of this volume in the aggregate. A value of 'volume' reserves space on the aggregates for the entire volume. A value of 'none' reserves no space on the aggregates, meaning that writes can fail if an aggregate runs out of space. Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.7 or later.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ONTAP instance.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Override the default port (80 or 443) with this port

options.name: https
options.description: Enable and disable https. Ignored when using REST as only https is supported. Ignored when using SSL certificate authentication as it requires SSL.

options.name: junction_path
options.description: Junction path of the cache volume.

options.name: key_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client key file.

options.name: lambda_config
options.description: Configuration parameters for AWS Lambda proxy functionality. These option and suboptions are only supported with REST.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the target volume for the FlexCache.

options.name: ontapi
options.description: The ontap api version to use

options.name: origin_cluster
options.description: Name of the origin cluster for the FlexCache. Defaults to cluster associated with target vserver if absent. Not used for creation.

options.name: origin_volume
options.description: Name of the origin volume for the FlexCache. Required for creation.

options.name: origin_vserver
options.description: Name of the origin vserver for the FlexCache. Required for creation.

options.name: override_encryption
options.description: If set to true, a plaintext FlexCache volume for an encrypted origin volume is created. Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.14.1 or later.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the specified user.

options.name: prepopulate
options.description: prepopulate FlexCache with data from origin volume. requires ONTAP 9.8 or later, and REST support. dir_paths must be set for this option to be effective.

options.name: relative_size
options.description: Only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.13.1 or later.

options.name: size
options.description: Size of cache volume.

options.name: size_unit
options.description: The unit used to interpret the size parameter.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified relationship should exist or not.

options.name: time_out
options.description: time to wait for flexcache creation or deletion in seconds if 0, the request is asynchronous default is set to 3 minutes

options.name: use_lambda
options.description: Specifies if AWS Lambda proxy functionality should be used to connect to the ONTAP system. Supported only with REST.

options.name: use_rest
options.description: Whether to use REST or ZAPI. always -- will always use the REST API if the module supports REST. A warning is issued if the module does not support REST. An error is issued if a module option is not supported in REST. never -- will always use ZAPI if the module supports ZAPI.  An error may be issued if a REST option is not supported in ZAPI. auto -- will try to use the REST API if the module supports REST and modules options are supported.  Reverts to ZAPI otherwise.

options.name: username
options.description: This can be a Cluster-scoped or SVM-scoped account, depending on whether a Cluster-level or SVM-level API is required. For more information, please read the documentation U(https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap/authentication/create-svm-user-accounts-task.html). Two authentication methods are supported 1. Basic authentication, using username and password. 2. SSL certificate authentication, using a ssl client cert file, and optionally a private key file. To use a certificate, the certificate must h

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(False) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vserver
options.description: Name of the target vserver for the FlexCache. Note that hostname, username, password are intended for the target vserver.

options.name: writeback
options.description: FlexCache Writeback. Requires ONTAP 9.12 or later and only supported with REST.
